verification_summary.balance_notes: SD16: Bangs 9 items + 20 endorsements; Armitage 10 items + 11 endorsements; Finkle 10 items + 0 endorsements (her statement says she seeks none). Tiers mostly T1 pamphlet plus T3 voter guide/news for Bangs and Armitage. Finkle's only non-pamphlet source is a self-bylined Tillamook Headlight Herald piece (downgraded T2 to T3 with disclosure). Spot search found uncollected T3 coverage: Capital Chronicle 2025-07-08 (Bangs endorsement by Weber) and a Capital Chronicle profile of Armitage; Finkle has no campaign domain. Balance acceptable.
